description: Machine-readable validation test fixture for the recovered protocol manifest schemas. Run with any JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 validator (e.g. ajv, jsonschema). All cases reference the live manifest at docs/ethics/recovered_protocols/recovered_protocol_manifest.json.

test_cases.rationale: The live manifest must always satisfy its own schema. Failure here means either the manifest or the schema drifted.

test_cases.description: Each protocol entry's custody_record validates against custody_record.schema.json
test_cases.rationale: Every custody_record must conform independently. Validates field names, enum values, and SHA patterns.
The if/then branch in custody_record.schema.json must bind correctly for SHADOWFAX.
Wiring gate requires this posture until all protocols are custody-verified and pentest is signed.

test_cases.description: NEGATIVE: custody_record missing required field source_package_sha256 must fail
test_cases.rationale: All 11 fields are required. A manifest entry missing any of them must be rejected by the schema.

test_cases.description: NEGATIVE: invalid source_package_sha256 format (not PENDING and not 64-char hex) must fail
test_cases.rationale: Hash fields must be either 'PENDING' or a valid 64-char lowercase hex string.

test_cases.description: NEGATIVE: SHADOWFAX with source_classification=missing_dependency and promotion_decision=pending_custody_verification must fail
test_cases.rationale: The SHADOWFAX hard-block constraint must be enforced by the schema, not just by convention.

test_cases.description: NEGATIVE: manifest with runtime_posture absent must fail

inline_instance.canon_posture: Recovered protocol records are custody fixtures only.

test_cases.rationale: runtime_posture is a required field. Its absence removes the planning-only safety constraint.

coverage_notes: TC-001 through TC-004 are minimum passing tests. All must pass before #1150 (fixture intake) proceeds.
TC-NEG-001 through TC-NEG-004 are regression guards. Any schema change that causes a NEG test to pass is a regression.
Additional protocol-specific tests (per #1152 and #1153) will extend this file for Moriarty containment and Tribunal appeal field validation.
